item.title: Solar System formed from fire, not ice, study finds
item.description: Ancient iron meteorites show some of the Solar System's first solid bodies were built mostly from tiny heat-forged rock beads called chondrules.

item.title: Major US reservoir hits record low
item.description: Lake Powell has fallen to its lowest level on record after an exceptionally dry and warm winter left the Colorado River Basin with little mountain snow.
